value: This article introduces Reed College as a transformative liberal arts institution, detailing its distinctive academic experience centered on deep inquiry and intellectual growth. It highlights a unique approach to learning, including an emphasis on thoughtful feedback over traditional grades, robust undergraduate research opportunities culminating in a required senior thesis, and the foundational Humanities 110 program. The piece also outlines Reed's holistic, test-blind admissions process designed to attract passionate learners, and showcases its vibrant campus life situated near Portland, Oregon.
